question: Who among the following played an important role in the establishment of the Indian National Congress?
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​Allan Octavian Hume.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points**__

__
 
• 
 In the year 1883, **Allan Octavian Hume** wrote an open letter to the graduates of Calcutta University.
 
 
• 
 Having been an associate of the **University of Calcutta since 1870**, he appealed to them to form their own **national political movement. **
 
 
• 
 This was conducted in** 1885 at the first session of the Indian National Congress** organized in Bombay.
 
 
• 
 Allan Octavian Hume, a retired British official, played an important role in starting the **Indian National Congress in 1885. **
 
 
• 
 He desired to create a platform for **political dialogue** between educated Indians.
 
 
• 
 He was also an ornithologist, and he is popular as the **"Father of Indian Ornithology." **
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• 
 From 1874 to 1877,** Charles Bernard **was Chief Commissioner of the Central Provinces.**​ **
 
 
• 
 In October 1867,**Sir Henry Cotton** joined the Bengal Civil Service.
 
 
• 
 **Sir Henry Cotton** registered his book** "New India" or "India in Transition" in the year 1885, when **Henry Cotton was in the Civil Service.
 
 
• 
 **Walter Badock** was Accountant-General at the India Office from **1907 to 1919.**
